name: Albania Highlights
summary: A relaxed north-to-south loop for travellers who want to see as much of Albania as nine days allows: the Alps, the castles, the winery table, the boat day and the Riviera, ending in Tirana.

priceTiers.label: Self-drive
priceTiers.covers: 3-star plus hotels, half board, vehicle and vehicle insurance

priceTiers.label: With an English-speaking driver-guide
priceTiers.covers: adds fuel, tolls, parking and entry fees

priceTiers.label: Premium hotels with driver-guide
priceTiers.covers: 4 and 5-star stays where the route allows

routeStops.note: Arrive at Tirana's Mother Teresa Airport and travel north for the first night in the lakeside university town.
The ferry through the Komani gorges, then up into the Valbona valley under the Accursed Mountains.
South to Skanderbeg's hilltop castle, the museum and the old bazaar.
The town of a thousand windows. The night is spent in a family-run guest house inside the castle walls.
A winery in the Ardenica hills, cooking from the grandmother's recipes, then on to Vlora.
By boat to Albania's only island, once a Cold War base, and the beaches of the Karaburun peninsula.
The Ionian coastline: Himara, Porto Palermo, Gjipe and Dhermi, with time for a swim.
The spring, then the UNESCO stone city, then north to the capital.
Depart Albania, or begin your own itinerary.

name: Albania Discovery
summary: The same country at half the pace: multi-night stays in four places instead of a new bed every night, with each day's excursion chosen on the day. Their word for it is unhurried, and it is the right word.

priceTiers.label: Self-drive
priceTiers.covers: 3-star plus hotels, half board, vehicle and vehicle insurance

priceTiers.label: With an English-speaking driver-guide
priceTiers.covers: adds fuel, tolls, parking and entry fees

priceTiers.label: Premium hotels with driver-guide
priceTiers.covers: 4 and 5-star stays where the route allows

entryOption: Start from Tirana, or fly to Corfu and cross to Sarande by ferry in about forty minutes.

routeStops.note: Settle in on the Riviera. Butrint, Ksamil, the Blue Eye, Gjirokastra and Permet are all day trips, or stay put on the esplanade.
Himara, Porto Palermo, Jal, Gjipe and Dhermi on the way north, ending inside Berat castle for the night.
Via the lake country of Belshi, with lunch at the Manushi family's table: her recipes, his home-made wine.
The capital's museums and cafes, Kruja's castle and bazaar, and the old Roman port of Durres.
Two nights in the north, with the lakes, the mountains and the scenic walks within reach.
Back to the capital in time for your departure.

name: Balkans Explorer
summary: Two weeks across four countries: the whole Albanian circuit plus Kosovo's monastery towns, Skopje, Lake Ohrid and a ferry day on Corfu. Border crossings are straightforward on an Australian passport.

priceTiers.label: Self-drive
priceTiers.covers: 3-star plus hotels, half board, vehicle, insurance and the return Corfu ferry

priceTiers.label: With an English-speaking driver-guide
priceTiers.covers: adds fuel, tolls, parking and entry fees

priceTiers.label: Premium hotels with driver-guide
priceTiers.covers: 4 and 5-star stays where the route allows

routeStops.note: Arrive and head north, then take the Komani ferry and walk the Valbona valley.
Across the Kosovo border to the 13th-century Decan Monastery and the cobbled streets of Prizren.
Into North Macedonia, with a local guide for the centre and the old Carshija quarter.
One of Europe's deepest and oldest lakes, with the night on the Albanian shore at Pogradec.
The old bazaar and Albania's oldest brewery, then a hotel in the pines at Voskopoja.
Along the wild river to a family farm, the thermal springs and the Lengarica canyon.
The stone city, the Blue Eye and Butrint, ending at a seafront hotel.
The forty-minute ferry across for a day in the old town, returning to Sarande.
Porto Palermo, Himara and Dhermi, then over the 1,100-metre pass to an alpine hotel and Caesar's Path.
The castle with a local guide, the Onufri Museum, and a converted house within the walls for the night.
The old Roman seaport, founded in 627 BC, then the capital until departure.
